question_papers.paper_title: Set 4 - Carbon and its Compounds Practice Paper

questions.question_text: Define structural isomerism and draw the structural formulas for the two isomers of butane (C4H10).
options: Option A
Option B
Option C
Option D
questions.correct_answer: Structural isomers have identical molecular formulas but different structural arrangements of carbon atoms. Isomers: 1. n-butane (CH3-CH2-CH2-CH3) and 2. Isobutane / 2-methylpropane [CH3-CH(CH3)-CH3].

question_papers.paper_title: Set 5 - Carbon and its Compounds Practice Paper

questions.question_text: Describe the structural components of a soap micelle and explain how it emulsifies oily dirt in water.
options: Option A
Option B
Option C
Option D
questions.correct_answer: A soap molecule has a hydrophilic ionic head (-COONa) facing outward into water and a hydrophobic hydrocarbon tail facing inward toward oil. Micelles trap oily dirt at their core and remain suspended in water.
